connector.name: XFuel
connector.registryDescription: Submit AI inference to XFuel, pay per task (USDC via x402 or TFUEL), fetch/verify ZK proofs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package xfuel-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xfuel-lab account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: XFUEL_API_URL
env.description: XFuel API base URL. Defaults to the hosted testnet demo.

env.name: XFUEL_API_KEY
env.description: API key sent as X-API-Key. Defaults to the shared public demo key.

env.name: XFUEL_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token required on the HTTP transport (Authorization: Bearer <token>).

env.name: XFUEL_RPC_URL
env.description: Theta RPC URL enabling verify_proof's optional on-chain nullifier read.

env.name: XFUEL_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Funded payer private key that enables the pay_with_usdc tool. Moves USDC — keep secret; use a low-balance wallet.
